links.outcome: Surgery rates under IOTA-ADNEX-guided vs retrospectively calculated RMI-based triage
links.effect: 10% (32/334) underwent surgery under general gynaecology and cancer unit team using IOTA-ADNEX at 10% threshold vs 30% (94/334) would have under RMI triage.
links.quote: In comparison, 30% (94/334) would have undergone surgery under the same teams if RMI-based triage had been used.

unlisted_practices: Qualitative identification of implementation barriers and facilitators for a predictive risk model, including clinical leadership and quality assurance sessions

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world clinical implementation and mixed-methods outcomes of the IOTA-ADNEX risk prediction model in NHS one-stop clinics compared to standard triage (RMI), but does not compare specific deployment practices/safeguards head-to-head.
